# `code_mode`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] code_mode`

Transform or refactor code files

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instruction` | string | yes | Natural language description of the transformation to apply |
| `language` | string | no | Programming language of the file (optional) |
| `path` | string | yes | Path to the code file to transform |
